column1: # everyday-baseline.tsv -- the blessed state of tools/everyday-smoke.pl (task #2099).
# THIS FILE LISTS WHAT IS WRONG.  A program that matches perl has NO row, exactly
# like baselines/fail-baseline.tsv.  Every row carries a CAUSE that explains THE
# FIRST DIFFERING STDOUT LINE -- a task number, or an anchor in
# ROWS LEAVE BY EDIT, with the batch that fixed them named in the commit message.
# There is deliberately no --bless-baseline: a baseline you can re-bless from a
# run is a baseline that absorbs regressions silently.
#   NEW          not `same`, no row here                     => the run exits 1
#   FIXED        a row whose program is now `same`           => edit the row out
#   MOVED        the first-diff line or the verdict changed  => re-attribute it
#   UNEXPLAINED  a row with an empty cause                   => the run exits 1
#   STALE        a row naming a program that is not there    => the run exits 1
# BLESSED s495e (2026-09-21) on 98313c26, gen v2-1740: 85 of 122 identical
# (idioms 38/42, index 10/19, modules 14/28, programs 23/33).  Every cause below
